title: Yellow Aerated Peruvian Seafood Picarones
description: A festive Peruvian dish featuring frozen seafood mix in a sweet and aerated picarone form, made with low glycemic ingredients and a double fry KFC method.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mashed sweet potato, pumpkin puree, eggs, coconut flour, and granulated sweetener, and mix until well combined.
Add the thawed seafood mix to the bowl and stir until the seafood is evenly distributed.
Using a piping bag or a spoon, drop the mixture into the hot oil, making sure not to overcrowd the pot.
Fry the picarones for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the picarones from the oil and place them on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
Increase the oil temperature to 375 degrees and fry the picarones again for an additional 2 minutes, until they are crispy and aerated.
Remove the picarones from the oil and sprinkle with salt.
Serve the Yellow Aerated Peruvian Seafood Picarones hot and enjoy.
